seed: Objects of type `wall` under action ACTION1 with touching neighbours [] show mixed outcomes: born x1, no_change x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a field of the object itself, such as its tags, pixels, visibility or layer. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks parsed from frame colours: axis row ring 10 (centre 0 when selected), solid targets 11, pieces ring 5 (centre 0 selected), reflections ring 4/centre 4 at row 2A-r.
A1/A2 move selection one block row; A3/A4 move selected piece (blocked by edge/other pieces), no-op for axis; A5 axis -> pieces by size desc -> axis.
Render layers piece > reflection > target > axis; centre = first solid else first fill else bg 9.
HUD column 63: one 11->12 from the top per effective (model-changing) action.
Hint 'wall A1 born/no_change' = target splitting the axis band in object extraction; irrelevant for frames. Unconfirmed: axis blocked by piece rows (never observed).
